title: Placement ladder (AIP-36 v1.4)
description: Validates the `placement` input of a session spawn (AIP-36 v1.4 §Placement ladder): an ordered list of rungs, each a sandbox plus optional model / access / preflight / turnRetry overrides. Mirrors `placementInputSchema` in agentproto/ts `packages/runtime/src/placement-ladder.ts:36-40`. Mutually exclusive with a top-level `sandbox` on the same spawn.

ladder.description: Rungs, tried in order. 1 to 8 (MAX_PLACEMENT_RUNGS, placement-ladder.ts:17).

rung.description: One placement choice (placement-ladder.ts:26-34). An axis the rung omits inherits the spawn's own top-level value (placement-ladder.ts:125-136).

sandbox.description: A provider slug, or an inline sandbox spec in the AIP-36 inline form (SANDBOX.schema.json). A rung always boots a fresh box: `reuse` is refused (placement-ladder.ts:115-120).

model.description: Model id for a session placed on this rung. A metered model id MUST be gated by an owner-controlled allowlist (AIP-36 v1.4 §5).

access.description: Auth profile override for this rung (AIP-69 profile refs).

preflight.description: Preflight probe ids run on the booted box before the agent starts, in order, stopping at the first `ko` (AIP-36 v1.4 §2). An id no probe is registered under fails the spawn with `sandbox_preflight_invalid`, which ends the walk.

turnRetry.description: Mid-run turn-retry policy for a session placed on this rung. Replaces, never merges with, the spawn's top-level `turnRetry`. `null` opts out. Mirrors `turnRetryInputSchema` (packages/runtime/src/turn-retry-policy.ts:199-230).

fallback.description: Ordered config overlays tried after same-config retries are exhausted; the reference implementation's subset of AIP-46 `ConfigOverlay`.
